profile.headline: C/C++ Software Developer
profile.summary:
Extensive experience in software development with hands-on experience in various product development roles, which include: individual contributor, architect/technical lead, performance lead, owner of customer relationships as well as handling critical escalations. Creative thinker and analytical problem-solver with demonstrated ability to resolve complex issues under pressure in fast-paced, time sensitive environments.
	
	Qualifications
•	Experienced programming in C/C++, STL, OpenSSL, Boost & Folly Libraries
•	Proficiency with Visual Studio Code, CMake, Git, Bitbucket, Jira, GDB, Perf Heat Maps
•	Knowledge of distributed systems, fault tolerance and resiliency
•	Knowledge of Ubuntu Linux and Linux kernel module and device driver development
•	Knowledge of AES, CRUSH, SAS, iSCSI, TCP/IP, and Fibre Channel Protocols
•	Experienced with Intel x86_64, ARM, and ARC Processors

positions.title: Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Core contributor to the Theon SDK, a quantum-resistant data security toolkit, from concept to product-ready in less than two years
•	Designed a set of high precision cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generators used to seed the encryption component of the Theon SDK
•	Integrated multiple arbitrary-precision math libraries used for performing high precision computations
•	Implemented performance analytics used to get insights that led to performance optimizations
•	Designed the CMake framework and Debian package for the Theon SDK
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Linux · C++ · Multithreading · CMake · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated the Stellus Data Platform (SDP) to the Azure Cloud:
•	Developed and enhanced the cluster elasticity component, which provided the ability to easily add and remove controller and storage nodes to and from the cluster
•	Provided infrastructure for the non-disruptive rolling upgrades
•	Worked closely with the Stellus Management Service team to coordinate the design and implementation of the cluster elasticity component
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Linux · C++ · Distributed Systems · Multithreading · CMake · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Core contributor to the Stellus Data Platform (SDP), an all-flash scale-out file and object storage system from concept to maket-ready in less than three years:
•	Designed and developed the data protection service layer, which provided resilience and recovery of storage nodes
•	Implemented end-to-end performance analytics for the controller nodes 
•	Designed and implemented the system test infrastructure, which simulated power fail and error injection of controller and storage nodes
•	Supported continuous integration testing with QA

Designed and developed for an all-flash block storage system:
•	The metadata I/O engine for the write-back cache
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Linux · C++ · Distributed Systems · Multithreading · CMake · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Core contributor to the FabricCache Intelligent Caching SAN Adapter
•	Linux Kernel module and device driver development on an embedded SoC platform
•	Designed and developed the metadata I/O engine for the write-back cache
•	Implemented performance analytics used to get insights that led to performance optimizations
•	Patent – Methods and Systems for Efficient Cache Mirroring
positions.insights: Skills: ARM · Fibre Channel · Linux Kernel · SATA

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description: •	BIOS/EFI integration of NVDIMM on Intel’s Enterprise Platform

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description: •	Software development for control subsystems used on military and commercial aircraft

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description: •	Contracted sole developer for the control subsystems used on a portable mass spectrometer

positions.title: Sr. Principal Engineer
positions.description: •	Technical lead on the ASIC verification (C to PLI) team assigned to design and implement a comprehensive verification strategy used throughout the development of an iSCSI, TCP and IP offload engine
positions.insights: Skills: TCL · iSCSI · SAS · ARC · TCP/IP · SATA · C · Multithreading

positions.title: Sr. Principal Engineer
positions.description:
•	Technical lead on the Gadzoox Fibre Channel switch protocol ASIC chip driver
•	Designed and implemented the Fibre Channel link level driver, the link initialization frame protocol layer, and the chip and system level diagnostic firmware used in hardware bring up

positions.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
positions.description: •	Member of the ASIC verification team assigned to the first-generation Fibre Channel chipset

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: •	Member of the SCSI group responsible for enhancing the functionality of the firmware.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: •	Member of the Controller development team assigned to build a high capacity disk controller.
